cohort: 3793 patients with placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) diagnosis and delivery indicators from the US National Inpatient Sample database between October 1, 2015, and December 31, 2019
finding: Placenta previa was associated with an increased risk of maternal and surgical morbidities and higher resource use among women with PAS.
mod_finding: This study found that patients with placenta previa were significantly more likely to undergo cesarean delivery than patients without placenta previa.
